rundown: Owls beat Owls 31-27 at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia, PA. Owls came back: they were down 10-7 at the half. The 4th quarter decided it: Owls won it 17-3. Their win chance dropped as low as 0% along the way.
Scoring: Owls 4 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Owls 3 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: P. Crayton Jr. pass to J. Brown for 30 yds, for a TD (T. Bauchiero KICK) (4th quarter, 0:06).

Leading the way — Owls: Patrick Crayton Jr. 5/10, 106 yds, 1 TD; D'Andre Hardeman Jr. 17 car, 137 yds, 1 TD; Max Mosey 3 rec, 62 yds, 1 TD. Owls: Jaxon Smolik 9/17, 110 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT; Keveun Mason 15 car, 98 yds; Colin Chase 4 rec, 54 yds, 1 TD.
Where Owls won it: they outgained them 458 yards to 410, won the turnover battle (1 to 2) and held the ball 34:10 to 25:50.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Owls closed as 2.5-point favorites and lost outright to Owls; Owls won as the underdog at +114; the total closed at 52.5 and they combined for 58, over by 5.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 7:27 PM ET. It had Owls 41% and Owls 59%, projecting Owls 22.5 – Owls 25.9 (48.4 total, Owls by 3.4).

Final: Owls 31 – Owls 27. Wrong winner: it had Owls at 59%, and Owls (41%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Owls came in with a 24% below average attack and a 24% leakier than average defense (1-9, 20.8 scored and 32.6 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 185 and 188 games of evidence. Projected to score 22.5, they scored 31 (+8.5 points, 38% over); projected to allow 25.9, they allowed 27 (+1.1 points, 4% over).

Owls came in with a 20% below average attack and a 21% leakier than average defense (2-8, 23.4 scored and 29.1 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 185 and 183 games of evidence. Projected to score 25.9, they scored 27 (+1.1 points, 4% over); projected to allow 22.5, they allowed 31 (+8.5 points, 38% over).

The bigger miss was Owls' scoring (+8.5 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 58 against 48.4 projected (+9.6), about the 73rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Owls by 4 against Owls by 3.4 projected, about the 31st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
TEM ML (-142) at -142: the algo gave it 57% vs 56% fair (+0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 55%). RICE ML (+120) at +120: the algo gave it 43% vs 44% fair (-0.2 pts) — won (+1.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 45%). TEM -2.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. RICE +2.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.2 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 52.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-0.9 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. UNDER 52.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 43% of bets on Owls, 62% of the money — Owls covered; total: 50% of bets on the over, 82% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 15% of bets on Owls, 23% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Owls, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.126 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -8.7 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 136 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Owls attack ×1.027, defense ×1.012 (3 games); Owls attack ×0.980, defense ×1.040 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
